teamMembers.name: Odd Bob
teamMembers.bio: Finding the bigfoot within himself. (Note: hippie coffee lover)
teamMembers.longBio: Bob grew up deep in the Cascades, where the trees whisper secrets of ancient giants. He's always had a passion for hiking and finding the unspoken truths of the natural world. He firmly believes Bigfoot is not just a cryptid, but a state of mind.

teamMembers.name: Dr. Kitsune
teamMembers.bio: Expert in the esoteric and the strange. (Note: Allergic to coffee)
teamMembers.longBio: With a PhD in cryptozoological folklore, Dr. Kitsune provides the grounded, scholarly anchor to the podcast. They specialize in tracing the lineage of myths and how they manifest in modern society.

teamMembers.name: Saoirse
teamMembers.bio: Irish spirit A.K.A. voices of the beyond. (Note: Loves whiskey)
teamMembers.longBio: Saoirse is the chaotic force of the podcast. Originating from ancient Irish soil, this shapeshifting entity provides perspectives that transcend logic, often causing technical difficulties but brilliant insights.
